repos.description: Map of org/repo keys to per-repository configuration.

checkout_directory.description: Relative path under JUDGE_WORKSPACE_ROOT for this repo's checkout.

merge_strategy.description: Default PR merge strategy for all repos.

max_executor_retries.description: Maximum number of executor retry attempts per work unit when judge reviews fail. Default: 10.

max_executor_retries_per_judge.description: Optional per-judge override of max_executor_retries (issue #122). Keys must be in the canonical judge allowlist (REVIEW_JUDGE_NAMES + SECURITY_JUDGE_NAMES). Each value falls back to max_executor_retries when absent.

use_bedrock.description: Whether to route LLM calls through AWS Bedrock.

bedrock_region.description: AWS region for Bedrock API calls.

judge_model.description: Model identifier used by judge agents.

executor_model.description: Model identifier used by the executor agent.

allowed_orgs.description: List of GitHub organisations permitted for operations.

display_timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London') applied by every devbench command that renders timestamps -- `devbench report`, `devbench hook-tail`, `devbench watch`, and any future command. When unset, each command defaults to the OS local timezone. Override per-invocation via the JUDGE_DISPLAY_TIMEZONE env var. Report-specific `report.display_timezone` / JUDGE_REPORT_TIMEZONE take precedence over this top-level setting for the report command only.

log_file.description: Workspace-relative path to the orchestrator's structured log file (for example 'logs/backlog-a-orchestrator.log'). When set, both `setup_logging` (the writer) and `cmd_report` (the reader) consult this single source of truth so the orchestrator and the report cannot read/write different files by accident. Per-invocation override via the JUDGE_LOG_FILE env var still takes precedence (useful for tests).

gh_api.description: GitHub API call timeout in seconds.

test.description: Test suite run timeout in seconds.

security_fetch.description: Security advisory fetch timeout in seconds.

llm.description: LLM API call timeout in seconds.

command.description: Shell command execution timeout in seconds.

executor.description: Executor agent overall timeout in seconds.

executor_max_turns.description: Maximum number of turns for the executor agent.

github_check.description: GitHub check status polling timeout in seconds.

update_submodule.description: When true, update the parent repo's submodule reference after each PR merge. Set to true only when target repos are git submodules of a parent workspace repo.

single_branch.description: When set, all work units use this branch name instead of per-unit backlog/<id> branches. Enables accumulating multiple commits on one branch for a single PR.

defer_pr.description: When true, git-ops commits locally only (no push, no PR, no merge). Use git-ops-finalize to push and create the PR after all work units are complete. Only meaningful when single_branch is set.

pause_before_merge.description: When true, cmd_git_ops pushes the PR and waits for green CI then transitions the work unit to in-review instead of merging; the orchestrator's loop reconciles in-review tasks via cmd_check_merge on the next iteration. Issue #101. Default false. Mutually exclusive with defer_pr: true and single_branch: <name> (validated at config load).

inline_orphan_cleanup.description: When true (the default), cmd_git_ops runs cleanup_tracked_orphans inline as a devbench-authored chore commit before the task's commit when build/state orphan paths are detected. When false, falls back to the legacy proposal-task path. Phase 1 of the orphan-cascade fix. Override via JUDGE_INLINE_ORPHAN_CLEANUP.

ci_failure_retry.description: When true (the default), cmd_git_ops returns rc=2 on CI failure to trigger an executor retry with the failing-job log as feedback. When false, returns rc=1 BLOCKED on the first CI failure (legacy behaviour). Issue #115. Override via JUDGE_CI_FAILURE_RETRY_ENABLED.

orphan_patterns.description: Operator override of the built-in orphan-pattern fnmatch list (terraform state, terragrunt cache, Python pycache, coverage, etc.). When non-empty, REPLACES the built-in list entirely. Override via DEVBENCH_ORPHAN_IGNORE_PATTERNS. Default: [] (use the built-in list).

local_only.description: When true, the target repo(s) are treated as local-only -- no origin git remote, never pushed, no PRs, no CI. ensure_branch creates the work-unit branch off the local default branch (no 'git fetch origin'). Requires defer_pr: true, forbids pause_before_merge: true, and requires every entry in repos: to set an explicit default_branch:. Used for operational workflows (AWS teardowns, evidence capture, audits) where devbench drives work but does not edit application code. Default: false.

auto_finalize.description: When true, the orchestrate skill automatically invokes 'devbench git-ops-finalize <repo>' once all work units for the repo are terminal. Requires defer_pr: true. Incompatible with local_only: true (no remote to push to). A marker file at <workspace>/.devbench/auto-finalize-fired-<repo>.marker prevents duplicate invocations. Default: false.

auto_merge.description: When true, the orchestrate skill automatically invokes 'gh pr merge --<merge_strategy>' once the post-E7 CI watcher reports GREEN. Requires auto_finalize: true AND defer_pr: true. Incompatible with local_only: true. When the E7 watcher is absent, emits [AUTO_MERGE_SKIPPED] no_ci_watcher and skips. A marker file at <workspace>/.devbench/auto-merge-fired-<repo>.marker prevents duplicate invocations. Default: false.

pr_review_resolution.description: PR review-comment polling settings (issue #116). Disabled by default. When enabled, cmd_git_ops polls gh pr view for asynchronous bot review feedback (Copilot, Q-Dev, internal review bots) before merging.

enabled.description: Top-level toggle. When false (default), the entire phase is a no-op. Override via JUDGE_PR_REVIEW_RESOLUTION_ENABLED.

agents.description: Comma-separated allowlist of GitHub login names whose unresolved review comments block the merge. Empty default; populate when review bots are configured on the target repo. Override via JUDGE_PR_REVIEW_AGENTS.

decision_blocks.description: When true (default), reviewDecision == CHANGES_REQUESTED hard-blocks the merge regardless of bot allowlist. Override via JUDGE_PR_REVIEW_DECISION_BLOCKS.

settle_seconds.description: Total settle-window length in seconds for the PR review poll loop. Default 60. Override via JUDGE_PR_REVIEW_SETTLE_SECONDS.

poll_interval.description: Per-poll cadence in seconds inside the settle window. Default 5. Override via JUDGE_PR_REVIEW_POLL_INTERVAL.

max_blocks.description: Maximum consecutive stop-hook blocks before circuit breaker trips and allows stop. Default: 5.

window_seconds.description: Time window in seconds for counting stop-hook blocks. Counter resets after this period. Default: 180.

stale_task_minutes.description: Minutes before an in-progress task is considered stale. Hook warns instead of blindly blocking. Default: 120.

hook_tail.description: devbench hook-tail column-cap settings (issue #134). EVENT_WIDTH stays a hook_tail.py-local constant; the four below are the operator-tunable knobs.

agent_width.description: Column width for the agent name. Default: 12.

tool_width.description: Column width for the tool name. Default: 8.

description_max.description: Max chars for the description column. Default: 120 (bumped from 100 in the release that introduces this block).

stdout_preview_max.description: Max chars for the result-preview column after the pipe. Default: 80.

max_cascade_depth.description: Cap on recovery-of-a-recovery cascade depth. When a proposal would land at depth >= this cap, the source task transitions to NEEDS_OPERATOR_ATTENTION instead of materialising another recovery layer. Default: 2.

alert_summary.description: Maximum number of security alert summaries to include.

output_truncation.description: Character limit for command output truncation.

llm_evidence_truncation.description: Character limit for LLM evidence content truncation.

llm_file_context.description: Maximum number of files included in LLM context.

llm_file_preview_chars.description: Character limit for per-file LLM preview.

ci_failure_log_bytes.description: Byte cap for the trimmed failing-job log written to .devbench/ci-failures/<id>-<n>.log when ci_failure_retry is enabled. Default 32768. Override via JUDGE_CI_FAILURE_LOG_BYTES.

debug.description: Diagnostic-tuning knobs. Set these only when investigating a specific orchestrator-cadence problem; production workspaces leave this section absent.

check_registration_retries.description: Number of times wait_for_checks retries gh pr checks when 'no checks reported' contradicts the local workflow-file glob (issue #114 race-defence). Default 12. Override via JUDGE_CHECK_REGISTRATION_RETRIES.

check_registration_delay_seconds.description: Sleep between check-registration retries, in seconds. Default 5. Override via JUDGE_CHECK_REGISTRATION_DELAY_SECONDS.

blocked_recovery_window_seconds.description: Recency cap for the AWAITING_AUTO_RECOVERY signal in the 3-state blocked-task classifier. Tasks whose most recent [BLOCKED] audit-comment timestamp is older than this window fall through to NEEDS_OPERATOR_ATTENTION. Default 1800. Override via JUDGE_BLOCKED_RECOVERY_WINDOW_SECONDS.

token_cost_per_million_input.description: Cost per million input tokens in USD. Default: 15.0 (Opus list price).

token_cost_per_million_output.description: Cost per million output tokens in USD. Default: 75.0 (Opus list price).

display_timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/Denver', 'Europe/London') for displaying timestamps in `devbench report`. Defaults to the host system's local timezone. Useful when running inside a devcontainer or VM whose system TZ differs from your actual location. Override via JUDGE_REPORT_TIMEZONE env var.

cache_read_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier for cache-read tokens, relative to base input rate. Defaults to 0.10 (Anthropic's published rate). Override only when running on a platform with different caching pricing (e.g. some Bedrock configurations).

cache_write_5min_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier for 5-minute prompt-cache write tokens, relative to base input rate. Defaults to 1.25 (Anthropic's published rate).

cache_write_1hr_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier for 1-hour prompt-cache write tokens, relative to base input rate. Defaults to 2.0 (Anthropic's published rate).

data_residency_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier applied per-call to usage.inference_geo-flagged tokens (issue #124). Defaults to 1.10 (Anthropic's published rate). Composes with cache + base-rate multipliers and applies before token_cost_discount.

fast_mode_multiplier.description: Cost multiplier applied per-call to usage.speed=='fast' tokens (issue #124). Defaults to 6.0 (Opus 4.6 fast-mode premium). Composes with cache + base-rate multipliers and applies before token_cost_discount.

recent_pace_tasks.description: Number of most-recently-completed tasks averaged for the 'Recent pace' projection in `devbench report`. Defaults to 10. Lower for more responsiveness, higher for more stability. Override via JUDGE_REPORT_RECENT_PACE_TASKS env var.

token_cost_discount.description: Contract discount (correction factor) off list-price token cost, as a fraction in [0.0, 1.0]. final_cost = raw_list_cost * (1 - token_cost_discount). Default 0.0 (no discount, pay full list). Applies uniformly to every per-call cost and to every ETA projection; cache multipliers stay as pure ratios applied to the discounted base rate. Override via JUDGE_REPORT_TOKEN_COST_DISCOUNT env var. See docs/model-pricing.md.

manifest_amendment.description: Opt-in configuration for the Changes Manifest amendment workflow. When enabled, executors that discover a required production fix during TDD GREEN can request an amendment to the Changes Manifest; a dedicated judge reviews the request, and on approval the manifest is updated atomically with a Layer 3 deterministic post-check.

enabled.description: Whether the amendment workflow is active for this backlog. Default false (opt-in).

allowed_reasons.description: List of amendment reasons this backlog accepts. Amendment requests whose reason is not in this list are rejected by the Layer 1 pre-filter. Default: ['tdd_green_production_fix'].

max_requests_per_execution.description: Maximum amendments applied to one task during one executor run. Default 1. Prevents amendment loops.

backlog.description: Backlog lifecycle settings. Controls how new work units are created and what default status they receive (issue #189).

default_status_for_new_work_units.description: Lifecycle status written into the '## Status:' line of every newly created work-unit file. Use 'draft' to require explicit human promotion before the orchestrator picks up the task. Use 'in-queue' (the default) for the legacy behaviour where new tasks are picked up immediately. AC-189-8 and AC-189-9.

task_factory.description: Opt-in configuration for the task-factory loop. When enabled, the orchestrator invokes blocker-resolver + task-factory after an amendment reject to generate new `proposed` work units for the out-of-scope production fixes the amender surfaced. Requires manifest_amendment.enabled: true.

enabled.description: Whether the task-factory loop runs after amendment rejects. Default false (opt-in). Requires manifest_amendment.enabled: true.

auto_accept_proposals.description: When true, devbench auto-promotes every task-factory-produced draft at sweep time instead of leaving it at status `proposed` for operator review. Default false. ADR-11.

validate.description: Opt-in toggles for additional validate-backlog rules. Existing rules (1-19) run unconditionally; rules listed here are gated to keep pre-existing backlogs green during rollout.

check_orphan_path_tokens.description: Rule 20: cross-check Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done sections of every Task against the Changes Manifest. Backtick-quoted path-shaped tokens that do not appear in the Manifest (and are not declared read-only via a trailing `(ref)` marker) emit an integrity error. Catches spec drift where AC/DoD prose restates a path that disagrees with the Manifest. Default false (opt-in). See docs/backlog-contract.md.
